label: member of
definition: Person, country or organization X is or becomes a member of organization or political group Y.
scope_notes: Member-of, membership, entry/accession and join provide the membership component. Joining someone in an action or alliance is distinct from becoming a constituent member; bare join without its completion can be ambiguous. Diplomatic relations, borders and television-title fragments do not establish membership.

facts.reason: Russia joins the United States in a bare path, but other evidence is diplomatic relations, migration, ambassador, criticism and comparison. The omitted complement prevents deciding whether join means membership or participation in a joint action.
facts.reviewer_question: What is the full complement of Russia joins the United States: membership in an organization or joining it in a particular action?

facts.reason: Israel has a treaty, ambassador, relations, occupied territory and a border involving Egypt; none identifies membership in an organization or group.
American modifies an ambassador, official and attaché in Paris, describing nationality and diplomatic location rather than membership.
NBC News and Press are connected through program and meet paths consistent with a program-title fragment; no membership role is present.
Democrats join or join with Republicans, plus a register path. The available paths do not distinguish party switching by particular individuals from temporary bipartisan cooperation by groups.
facts.reviewer_question: Do the join/register sentences describe individual Democrats becoming Republican members, or groups cooperating while retaining different party membership?
